link_notes: The digest has no paper, and the code is Synthea, a rule-based patient simulator, which does not clearly match a method called template note generation.

open_release.rationale: Synthea generates synthetic patients from rules and census statistics rather than copying real records.

quotes.text: The goal is to output synthetic, realistic (but not real), patient data and associated health records in a variety of formats.

pipeline_testing.rationale: The README lists many output formats (FHIR, C-CDA, CSV) but never states a testing or development-data purpose.

quotes.text: Bulk FHIR in ndjson format (set `exporter.fhir.bulk_data = true` to activate)

ml_augmentation.rationale: The README shows no model training or augmentation use.

statistical_replication.rationale: The README only says output follows census-based demographics; no fidelity evaluation is shown.

quotes.text: Configuration-based statistics and demographics (defaults with Massachusetts Census data)

causal_inference.rationale: Disease modules are rule-based simulation, but no causal framing is stated.

education.rationale: The README does not mention teaching or demonstration use; the wiki was not in the digest.

benchmarking.rationale: The README does not position Synthea as a baseline or benchmark.

imbalance_correction.rationale: No class-imbalance framing appears in the README.
